([[Preston, Lancashire]]) | college = *[[Drexel Dragons men's basketball|Drexel]] (2020–2024) *[[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky]] (2024–present) | highlights = *3× [[Coastal Athletic Association|CAA]] Defensive Player of the Year (2022–2024) *2× First-team All-CAA (2023, 2024) *Third-team All-CAA (2022) *3× CAA All-Defensive Team (2022–2024) }} '''Amari Williams''' (born January 28, 2002) is a British [[college basketball]] player who plays for the [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky Wildcats]] of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. He previously played for the [[Drexel Dragons men's basketball|Drexel Dragons]]. ==Early life== Williams grew up in [[Nottingham]], [[England]] and initially attended [[Trinity School, Nottingham]].{{cite web|url=https://www.nottinghampost.com/news/nottingham-news/meet-six-foot-eight-16-1869443|title=Meet the six foot eight 16-year-old who's a rising star in the basketball world|first=Rod|last=Malcolm|work=[[Nottingham Post]]|date=August 7, 2018|access-date=October 25, 2024}} He transferred to [[Myerscough College]] when he was 16 years old.{{cite web|url=https://www.inquirer.com/college-sports/drexel/drexel-basketball-mate-okros-amari-williams-20220114.html|title=Drexel basketball duo's bond stretches from across the pond|first=Ariel|last=Simpson|work=[[The Philadelphia Inquirer]]|date=January 14, 2022|access-date=October 25, 2024}} Williams primarily played [[Association football|football]] when growing up.{{cite web|url=https://www.kentucky.com/sports/spt-columns-blogs/mark-story/article294021474.html|title=Why a 7-foot Englishman could be the key to Mark Pope’s first Kentucky men’s basketball season|first=Mark|last=Story|work=[[Lexington Herald-Leader]]|date=October 17, 2024|access-date=October 25, 2024}} ==College career== Williams began his college career with the Drexel Dragons. He was named the [[Colonial Athletic Association]] (CAA) Defensive Player of the Year and third-team all-conference as a sophomore. Williams repeated as CAA Defensive Player of the Year and was named first-team all-conference while averaging 13.7 points, 8.8 rebounds, and 2.2 blocks per game.{{cite web|url=https://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/college/kentucky/2024/04/21/amari-williams-stats-247-transfer-kentucky-basketball-drexel-dragons-mark-pope-nba-draft/73407020007/|title=Who is Amari Williams? Mark Pope, Kentucky basketball land Drexel star F, per reports|first=John|last=Leuzzi|work=[[Courier Journal]]|date=April 21, 2024|access-date=October 25, 2024}} As a senior, Williams averaged 12.2 points, 7.8 rebounds, and 1.8 blocks per game and was named the CAA Defensive Player of the Year for a third straight season.{{cite web|url=https://www.inquirer.com/college-sports/drexel/drexel-basketball-amari-williams-caa-defensive-player-award-20240307.html|title=Drexel's Amari Williams earns third CAA Defensive Player Award|work=[[The Philadelphia Inquirer]]|date=March 7, 2024|access-date=October 25, 2024}} After the end of the season, Williams decided to utilize the extra year of eligibility granted to college athletes who played in the 2020–2021 season due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]] and entered the NCAA transfer portal.{{cite web|url=https://www.inquirer.com/college-sports/drexel/drexel-amari-williams-nba-draft-ncaa-transfer-portal-20240312.html|title=Drexel star forward Amari Williams to see what the NBA draft and NCAA transfer portal might offer|first=Kerith|last=Gabriel|work=[[The Philadelphia Inquirer]]|date=March 12, 2024|access-date=October 25, 2024}} Williams transferred to [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/39990904/drexel-transfer-amari-williams-commits-kentucky|title=Agent: Drexel transfer Amari Williams commits to Kentucky|first=Jeff|last=Borzello|website=[[ESPN.com]]|date=April 21, 2024|access-date=October 25, 2024}} ==National team career== Williams has represented [[Great Britain men's national basketball team|Great Britain]] in international competitions at the under-16, under-18, and under-20 levels.{{cite web|url=https://drexeldragons.com/news/2022/6/23/mens-basketball-williams-selected-to-represent-great-britain-in-world-cup-qualifiers|title=Williams Selected to Represent Great Britain in World Cup
